'''Corellian Mist''' was a glucose supplement consumed as a meal in itself by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:CM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=item|Corellian Mist}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Corellian Mist appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Corellian Mist was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 20|Game Update 20]]" on [[August 18]], [[2011]].<ref name="GU20">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=69207&month=082011|text=Game Update 20: Galactic Civil War 2 – Space}}</ref>
